post.description: Confirm password reset with the verification code and set a new password. Returns JWT tokens upon success.

Change the password for the authenticated user. Requires the current password for verification. Returns new JWT tokens.

token if the refresh token is valid.
Register a new user account. A confirmation email will be sent to the provided email address.

post.description: Resend a verification code. Purpose: '0' for email confirmation, '1' for password reset.

Takes a token and indicates if it is valid.  This view provides no
information about a token's fitness for a particular use.
